images.caption: Figure 2:Overview ofP2-MOPD. Each projection of the student is composed as its own learnable full weight plus a learnable linear combination of frozen expert directions,Wm=Bm+∑kαk,m​τk,mW_{m}=B_{m}+\sum_{k}\alpha_{k,m}\tau_{k,m}(Equation4), and the composed weights are used as one model for the forward pass. The student generates rollouts on prompts of all domains; the frozen teacher of each prompt’s domain scores the student’s tokens. The sampled tokens and the teacher logits are passed as detached data flow (gray lines), and the resulting MOPD loss is back-propagated to the student weights (student weight channel) and to the coefficientsα\alpha(coefficient channel). No gradient reaches the experts or the teachers, which come from the same expert bank.
